svg.aria-label: The Chio kernel boundary: agents, sub-agents, and tool servers run untrusted in user space; every call crosses into the kernel, which verifies, budgets, guards, dispatches, meters, and signs; protocol and provider adapters sit beneath it as drivers; every decision lands in an append-only receipt log.
